title: Universal Corporation Releases FY2025 Sustainability Report
summary: Report Showcases Significant Gains in Renewable Energy, Emissions Reduction, and Farmer Support Universal Corporation (NYSE:UVV), (“Universal” or the “Company”), a global business-to- business agriproducts company, announces the release of its 2025 Sustainability Report. “Building on decades of commitment, sustainability remains central to Universal’s strategy and long-term success,” said Preston D. Wigner, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer of Universal Corporation. “By integrating sustainability into our global business, we are better positioned to serve customers, support farmers, strengthen our supply chain, and protect the environment.” During fiscal year 2025, Universal achieved significant progress towards its sustainability goals including: Environmental Progress: Increased renewable electricity consumption by nearly sixfold, with 17.8% of global electricity sourced from renewables, advancing toward net-zero emissions by 2050.
